facts.text: Staplehurst was founded in 1876, growing from prairie roots into a community that values its history and future together.
The village’s name comes from Staplehurst, England, chosen by early settlers who were natives of that town.
When the railroad reached the area in 1879, Staplehurst was officially established, marking the start of its modern era.
Staplehurst prides itself on preserving small‑town character while fostering thoughtful development and protecting its natural treasures.
Good Ol Days Bar & Grill, famous for its gizzard baskets, offers a taste of local comfort food that keeps neighbors coming back.
Staplehurst embraces a wholesome lifestyle, rich in cultural history, and is deeply committed to preserving its environment.
